entries.2c81401a62beb91d: This is a market category for the marine vessel market. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,423 million. Products are delivered to individual shipyards and include marine exhaust gas valves that comply with the IMO's NOx3 regulations, capturing needs in the environmental measures field.
entries.81822d29d03fa988: A valve manufacturer headquartered in Yasu, Shiga Prefecture, that makes fluid control equipment centered on butterfly valves and sells it to the land-use and marine markets.
entries.96ab4109ea203ca0: This is a market category for factory and building construction markets. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥4,691 million. The products are adopted by customers across a wide range of industries, including building services, petrochemicals, iron and steel and metals, electricity and gas, machinery and equipment, and pulp and paper.
entries.c25efc232ce75ef9: A single segment that manufactures and sells fluid control equipment, centered on butterfly valves. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,114 million, and by product, butterfly valves accounted for 84% of revenue. Consolidated subsidiaries OKM VALVE(M)SDN.BHD. (Malaysia) and Okumura Valve (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. (China) manufacture and sell products for overseas markets as the company's outsourced production sites.
